mechanism_classification.learned_object: Online state-conditioned command-to-behaviour mapping of an existing fixed low-level controller under perturbations
mechanism_classification.global_model: Differential-drive velocity scaling with a degree-3 polynomial state dependence, fitted by least squares
mechanism_classification.local_model: RBF Gaussian-process residual using the fitted global model as fixed mean for each update
mechanism_classification.command_selection: Grid inverse mapping over 101 by 101 candidate velocity commands
mechanism_classification.rl_in_paper: Online residual TD3 baseline; fails tested Chicane completion under safety stopping criterion

essential_boundaries: 74.4 percent is median recovery of perturbation-induced tracking-error overhead across sections, not a 74.4 percent reduction of total tracking error.
225 ms is a model update/deployment time, not a universal closed-loop recovery-time guarantee.
Main controlled wind experiments are state-dependent track-speed scaling; true unmatched lateral forces are explicitly out of scope.
Transient command changes can be removed from training data; the learned static map is not a general finite-horizon transient model.
No task-specific pretraining still allows normal-condition GP hyperparameter calibration and pre-existing low-level controllers.
Improvement with a frozen low-level controller demonstrates better use of existing capabilities, not RL creating new motor skills.
The input grid and GP are not closed-loop safety certificates. Core stability and safety are delegated to the low-level controller.
TD3 failures cannot be generalized to all RL, trained RL or MPC-RL co-design. Ramp/Wind/Robustness TD3 were not run.
unresolved_items: Earliest public manuscript date and relationship to any earlier public manuscript remain unknown.
Main p10 equations 4 and 5 use inconsistent angular-velocity signs; supplementary p11 equations 10-13 give a consistent alternative that matches main equation 6.
Main equation 8 prints sign(s), whose relationship to the sign of learned perturbation d'(s) requires source-code verification.
Reset metric adapted/unadapted command correspondence remains ambiguous in the text; no source implementation audit was performed.
Main p7 says 18 degrees of freedom per leg; supplementary p7 states 18 total and is used here.
Minor numerical prose conflicts remain between supplementary Wind 74.7 percent and main table 74.4 percent; formal main table used.
Full raw-data statistical recomputation, video viewing, official code execution and independent reproduction were not performed.
Complete TD3 interaction/update budget, MAP-Elites pretraining cost, development/tuning cost and deployment latency distribution are not established by this reading.
